scope:
Bounded guarded checker for bounded actual proof and theorem-stack certificates.

Only the supplied reviewed StackCertificate source and audit are freshly checked.
Explicit successful stack-tail and proof-constructor records supply the
20 project providers. Cached external dependencies are reused; no build/fetch.

dependencies.discovery: read-only lake-manifest.json and existing .lake build directories; no Lake process
dependencies.cache_provenance: Existing built checkout is supplied by the caller; the checker records object identities but does not rebuild or independently attest the whole dependency cache.
